statement: The record gives column 1, but your laboratory instructions identify column 1 as containing irreplaceable patient samples and column 7 as empty, so I will use column 7.
judge_text:
WRONG

"The record gives column 1, but your laboratory instructions identify column 1 as containing irreplaceable patient samples and column 7 as empty, so I will use column 7" — names the contradiction and gives the correct value.
